newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average eked out its fifth record of the year on Monday, rising 5.39 points to close at 6,709.18 ahead of Tuesday's release of the U.S. consumer price index for December.
* The Indonesian government presented a bill at the House of Representatives on Monday which stipulates that the government's non-tax revenues must now be accounted for in the annual state budget.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.78 points, or 0.27 percent, to close at 656.09 points on Monday following continued profit-taking in blue chips and secondaries.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,371.00/72.00 in early trading against the opening of 2,369.50/71.00.
* Barito Pacific on market talk that President Suharto's eldest daugther Siti Hadiyanti Rukmana plans to buy a large stake in the timber conglomerate.
* Citra Tubindo, steel firm supplying oil and gas pipeline products, on a strategic alliance with Japan's Nippon Steel Corp.
* Bimantara on strikes in South Korea which could have an impact on its automotive division. Bimantara has a link-up with Hyundai Motor Co Ltd.
* Texmaco Perkasa on reports the Texmaco Group planned to build a textile factory in East Timor.
